Zulu: Ababhali bathe inkundla yenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abalimi bayaqeqeshwa ukuze bandise ulwazi lwabo ngokukhiqiza i-chickpea.

Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gore sebaka se ile sa netefatša gore balemi ba hlahlwa mabapi le go oketša tsebo ya bona ka ga tšweletšo ya chickpea.
Amharic: ጸሃፊዎቹ መድረኩ ገበሬዎች ስለ ሽምብራ አመራረት ያላቸውን እውቀት እንዲያሳድጉ ስልጠና መሰጠቱን አረጋግጧል ብለዋል፡፡

Source: Farmers also attended events where they could share information and their experiences.
Luganda: Abalimi era baagenda ku mikolo kwe baali basobola okugabana obubaka bwe balina ne bye bayiseemu n’abantu abalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn àgbẹ̀ bákan náà lọ sí àwọn ètó níbi tí wọ́n ti lè ṣàlàyé àti àwọn ìrírí wọn.
Zulu: Abalimi baphinde bahambela imicimbi lapho bebengacobelelana ngolwazi nangamava abo.
Hausa: Haka nan kuma manoman sun halarci tarurruka inda za su iya raba bayanai da kuma abubuwan da suka faru da su.
Northern Sotho: Balemi ba ile ba tsenela ditiragalo fao ba bego ba ka fana ka tshedimošo le ka ga maitemogelo a bona.
Amharic: ገበሬዎቹ መረጃ እና ልምዳቸውን የሚለዋወጡባቸው ዝግጅቶች ላይም ተገኝተዋል፡፡

Source: The authors said the platform also linked farmers with buyers, and seed producers with those responsible for buying and distributing seeds to farmers.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baagamba nti ekibiina era kyataba abalimi n’abaguzi, n’abakola ensigo ne kibataba n’abo abavunaanyizibwa ku kugula n’okugabira abalimi ensigo.
Yoruba: Òǹkòwé náà sọ pé ẹgbẹ́ náà tún sàlárinà àwọn àgbẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn arajà, àti àwọn apèsè kóró pẹ̀lú àwọn tí wọ́n wà nídìí rírà àti pínpín àwọn kóró fún àwọn àgbẹ̀.
Zulu: Ababhali bathi le nkundla iphinde ixhumanise abalimi nabathengi, abakhiqizi bembewu nalabo ababhekele ukuthenga nokusabalalisa imbewu kubalimi.
Hausa: Marubutan sun ce dandalin ya kuma haɗa manoma da masu saye, da masu samar da iri da masu saye da kuma rarraba iri ga manoma.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gape gore sebaka se se amantšhitše balemi le bareki, le batšweletši ba didipeu le bao ba rwelego maikarabelo a go reka le go phatlalatša dipeu go balemi.
Amharic: መድረኩ ገበሬዎችን ከገዢዎች ጋር እንዲሁም ዘር አምራቾችን ደግሞ ዘር በመግዛት ለገበሬው የማካፈል ሃላፊነት ከተጣለባቸው አካላት ጋር ማገናኘቱንም ጸሃፊዎቹ ተናግረዋል፡፡

Source: The platform also formed and trained women and youth associations on chickpea production.
Luganda: Ekibiina era kyatondawo era ne kitendeka ebibiina by’abakyala n’abavubuka ku nnima ya chickpea.
Yoruba: Ẹgbẹ́ náà tún ṣàkójọ ẹgbẹ́ àwọn obìnrin àti ọ̀dọ́ tí wọ́n sì tún kọ́ wọn ní ìpèsè ẹ̀wà-ṣíìkì.
Zulu: Inkundla iphinde yakha futhi yaqeqesha izinhlangano zabesifazane nentsha mayelana nokukhiqizwa kwama-chickpea.
Hausa: Dandalin ya kuma kafa tare da horar da ƙungiyoyin mata da matasa a kan noman chickpea.
Northern Sotho: Sebaka se se ile sa hloma le go hlahla basadi le bafsa ka ga tšweletšo ya chickpea.
Amharic: መድረኩ የሴቶች እና የወጣቶች ማህበራትን በማቋቋም በሽምብራ አመራረት አሰልጥኗል፡፡

Source: They further encouraged women and youth to be involved in seed production.
Luganda: Baayongera ne bakubiriza abakyala n’abavubuka okwenyigira mu kukola ensigo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tẹ̀síwájú láti gba àwọn obìnrin àti àwọn ọ̀dọ̀ lámọ̀ràn láti lọ́wọ́ sí ìpèsè kóró.
Zulu: Baphinde bagqugquzela abesifazane nentsha ukuthi bazibandakanye ekukhiqizeni imbewu.
Hausa: Sun kuma ƙara ƙarfafa gwiwar mata da matasa da su shiga harkar noman iri.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba tšwela pele go hlohleletša basadi le bafsa go kgatha tema ka tšweletšong ya dipeu.
Amharic: በቀጣይም ሴቶች እና ወጣቶች በዘር ምርት ላይ እንዲሳተፉ አበረታተዋል፡፡

Source: The authors said that despite the achievements made, there was still a shortage of chickpea seeds.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baagamba nti newankubadde nga waaliwo obuwanguzi obwali butuukiddwako, waali wakyaliwo ebbula ly’ensigo za chickpea.

Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gore ka ntle le diphihlelelo tše di dirilwego, go be go sa na le tlhaelelo ya dipeu tša chickpea.

Source: They also said the platform could achieve more if they had resources to meet more regularly.
Luganda: Baayongerako era ne bagamba nti ekibiina kyali kisobola okubaako obuwanguzi obulala bungi bwe kituukako singa kyalina ebikozesebwa okusobola okusisinkana buli kaseera.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé ẹgbẹ́ náà lè ṣàṣeyọrí síi tí wọ́n bá ní àwọn ohun èlò láti máa bá a pàdé ní gbogbo ìgbà.

Source: They recommended that Ethiopia’s Ministry of Agriculture and researchers should support the platform with money so that it does not collapse.
Luganda: Baateesa nti Ekitongole ky’Obulimi mu ggwanga lya Ethiopia n’abanoonyereza basaanye badduukirire ekibiina n’ensimbi kireme kugwa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n dáa lábàá pé Ilé-iṣẹ́ Ètò Ọ̀gbìn orílẹ̀-èdè Ethiopia àti àwọn aṣèwádíí gbọdọ̀ ṣàtìlẹyìn fún ẹgbẹ́ náà pẹ̀lú owó kì ó má baà dẹnu kọlẹ̀.
Zulu: Bancome ukuthi uMnyango Wezolimo wase-Ethiopia nabacwaningi kufanele basekele inkundla ngemali ukuze ingawi.
Hausa: Sun bayar da shawarar cewa Ma'aikatar Aikin Gona ta Habasha da masu bincike su tallafa wa dandalin da kuɗi don kada ya rushe.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba šišinya gore Kgoro ya Temo ya ka Ethiopia le banyakišiši ba swanetše go thekga sebaka se ka tšhelete gore se seke sa phuhlama.
Amharic: መድረኩ እንዳይፈርስ የኢትዮጵያ ግብርና ሚኒስቴር እና ተመራማሪዎች የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ሊያደርጉ እንደሚገባ መክረዋል፡፡

Source: They also suggested improving chickpea quality and how chickpea production risks, such as diseases, are managed.

Yoruba: Wọ́n tún dábàá mímú ìdàgbàsókè bá ìwọ̀n ẹ̀wà-ṣíìkì àti bí ewu ṣe ń kojú ẹ̀wà-ṣíìkì bíi; kòkòrò, ṣe lè di dídèènà.

Source: Finally, the authors called for further improved seeds that would be easy to harvest using machines, and which were not affected by herbicides.
